source_pdf_sha256 binds a map to the current verified server PDF. A map is eligible only when its hash matches that PDF and its page ranges are contiguous from page 1 through the PDF page count. Unbound or gapped maps must be rebuilt directly with scripts/references/build_chapter_pages.py. No PDF text derivative is an input or output.
